doc.text: Welcome to today's episode of "Myths and Stories News!"
And now, for today's top story...
doc.headline: Fast Loris Coming Soon!
doc.text: For the first time ever, the slow loris is being buffed!
The slow loris's movement speed has been increased by 125 percent!
In addition, its attack and magic stats have each been increased by 3 tiers!
The buff is set to take effect following next Tuesday's scheduled maintenance window.
Be sure to check it out!
That's all for today... thanks for tuning into "Myths and Story's News!"
